# Official conformance protos

Vendored from [protocolbuffers/protobuf](https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf)
v29.3 (`conformance.proto`, `test_messages_proto3.proto`, and proto3 well-known
types). License: BSD, see the headers in each file.

These are **test inputs**. The runtime does not link official protobuf libraries.
`gld-protoc-mojo` generates Mojo from this tree.
